title: Sooo cool
text: Sooo cool. Oooo... very, very cool and very sort of retro.  I love how the light on the clock creates shadows that are flower shaped too!  It's large... about 23 or 24" in diameter... accurate to the ad posting.  The flowers have crystal like centers and are sparkly, but not overly so in the light.  For me, it's also all about the "sweep" hand... meaning the clock is absolutely silent!  There are no numbers... just lines where the numbers would be... and a quite large "QUARTZ" above the dash for "6"...  I would prefer that wasn't on the clock.. but not enough to send it back. The clock face is round.  I always update my reviews if any useful info comes to light.

product_metadata.title: Lulu Decor, Daisy Lines Decorative Metal Wall Clock, Size 23.50", Modern Wall Clock, Silent Non-Ticking, Quartz Movement, Perfect for Housewarming Gift (White)
